home.title: Digital checklists
home.subtitle: Build a checklist for a store, print the station QR code, and see what the kitchen submitted.

login.throttled: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
login.kitchenHint: Kitchen staff do not need to sign in: the checklist opens from the station QR code.

admin.signedIn: You are signed in. Choose a section.

sections.checklistsHint: Create a checklist and publish a version
sections.catalogHint: Add a pizzeria and its stations
sections.libraryHint: Create a block and insert it into checklists

fields.name: Name
fields.timezoneUnknown: The database does not know the zone “{timezone}”: the QR codes of this pizzeria's stations do not open. Pick a zone from the list and save.

confirm.deleteStoreBody: Stations will be deleted with it: {count}
confirm.deleteStoreWarning: If any station has submissions or check marks, deletion will be refused — history is untouchable. The shift mode is cleared together with the pizzeria.
confirm.deleteStationBody: Its QR code will stop opening the checklist.

assign.none: No checklist assigned — this station's QR code will open into nothing.

empty.stores: This country has no pizzerias yet
empty.stations: This pizzeria has no stations yet

errors.unknownTimezone: The database does not know this timezone
errors.referencedByHistory: Submissions reference this record — deletion is not allowed
errors.referencedByChecks: Check marks reference this record — deletion is not allowed
errors.countryNotEmpty: This country still has pizzerias — delete them first
errors.checklistArchived: This checklist is withdrawn — it cannot be assigned to a station
errors.codeCollision: This QR code is already taken — try again

list.title: Checklists
list.emptyHint: Create the first one: title, station, window — then start typing items.
list.filterEmptyHint: Nothing has been created under the current selection yet. Change it or create the first one.

section.pastePlaceholder: Paste the list here — one line per item
section.usedIn: also used in {count, plural, one {# checklist} other {# checklists}}
section.libraryHint: Items are edited in the block — the change reaches every draft it is inserted into. Published versions never change.

item.placeholder: Item text — Enter creates the next one

schedule.open: Set up how often this item is checked
schedule.title: How often the item is checked
schedule.hint: A periodic item is not part of the fill-in form: it is marked on rounds, on its schedule.
schedule.none: A plain item: marked once per fill-in.
schedule.limit: One item holds no more than {count, plural, one {# stretch} other {# stretches}}
schedule.emptySegment: Stretch {number}: start and end are the same — there would be no rounds at all.
schedule.remindEvery: Every {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
schedule.remindNeedsSchedule: The reminder starts working once there is at least one stretch.

versions.title: Versions
versions.hint: Publishing creates a new version. Submissions stay attached to the version they were filled against.

notice.station: The checklist is attached to station “{station}” of store “{store}”. Its QR code opens the version published at the moment of scanning.
notice.noStation: No station selected: until the checklist is attached to one, its QR code opens nothing.

preview.title: Preview
preview.notice: This is what an employee sees. It only shows: the employee answers and submits on their own phone, opening the checklist by the station QR code.
preview.left: {count, plural, one {# item left} other {# items left}}
preview.empty: The draft has no items yet
preview.roundsRemind: While overdue, reminds every {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
preview.roundsNote: These items are not part of the fill-in form: they are marked at the station when their time comes.

errors.badFormat: The checklist data was not accepted: check the fields and try again.
errors.tooManySections: Too many sections: no more than {limit}.
errors.tooManyItems: Too many items: no more than {limit}.
errors.textTooLong: Text is too long: no more than {limit} characters.
errors.badRange: The lower bound is above the upper bound.
errors.emptyWindow: The window starts and ends at the same time — such a checklist never opens.
errors.nothingToPublish: Nothing to publish: the checklist has no items.
errors.unknownBlock: The inserted library block was not found.
errors.unknown: Could not save. Please try again.

remove.title: Delete this checklist?
remove.name: Checklist
remove.willDelete: This checklist has no submissions — it will be deleted completely, together with its draft and versions. This cannot be undone.
remove.willArchive: This checklist already has submissions ({count}). They cannot be erased: they hold what the employee actually saw. So the checklist will leave the list and stop opening at the station, while the submission history stays in the feed.
remove.alreadyArchived: This checklist is already out of service. Its submission history stays in the feed.

notice.text: A sticker is printed once and lives for years: the QR belongs to the station, not to the checklist. Change the checklist — the sticker stays. Reissuing the code kills the old stickers: print new ones.
notice.origin: Codes on this sheet point to {origin}

sheet.title: Print sheet
sheet.meta: A4 · {count, plural, one {# station} other {# stations}}
sheet.empty: This store has no stations yet — nothing to print.

tablet.title: QR on the station tablet
tablet.hint: The same link as on the sticker. The tablet keeps the screen awake; when the code is reissued the picture updates itself.
tablet.empty: The store has no stations — nothing to show.

picker.title: Pick a store
picker.hint: A sheet is printed per store: it carries stickers for all of its stations.
picker.empty: No stores yet — add them in the reference.

errors.notFound: That station is gone: refresh the page.
errors.codeCollision: No free code was issued. Try reissuing again.

fill.left: {count, plural, one {# item left} other {# items left}}
fill.needComment: A comment on the failed item is required
fill.criticalHint: Critical — a comment is required if it fails
fill.failHint: A short note is enough — the manager will see it today.

sent.title: Done, thank you
sent.failed: {count, plural, one {# critical item failed} other {# critical items failed}}. The manager will see your comment today.

invalid.title: This code no longer works
invalid.text: The sticker has been replaced. Ask your manager for the new one — the old code was revoked.

none.title: Nothing to fill in right now
none.text: No checklist is assigned to this station for the current time of day.

choice.title: Which checklist?
choice.text: More than one checklist is open at this station right now. Pick the one you need.

offline.title: Could not send
offline.text: Your answers are kept on this screen. Move closer to the Wi-Fi and try again — nothing is lost.

refused.tooOften: Too often. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
refused.gone: This sticker is no longer valid — ask your manager for a new one.
refused.broken: The server did not accept the answers. Check the items and send again.

tooOften.title: Too many requests
tooOften.text: Wait a minute and scan the sticker again.

fill.majorHint: Major — a comment is required if it fails

refused.tooOften: The shift mode was changed too often. Try again in {minutes} min.
refused.failed: Could not set the shift mode. Please try again.
refused.offline: No connection. Your answers are still here — try again.

refused.noRound: No round is due right now: the checklist is closed or today's rounds are over.
refused.needComment: Say what you found — the mark is not accepted without it.
refused.tooOften: Too often. Try again in {minutes} min.
refused.broken: Could not mark it. Reload the page and try again.

filters.timeZone: The period is counted in store time: {zone}

metrics.failedCritical: {count, plural, one {failed critical item} other {failed critical items}}

alarms.title: Alarms
alarms.criticalFailed: {count, plural, one {a critical item was not done} other {# critical items were not done}}
alarms.criticalUnanswered: {count, plural, one {a critical item was left unanswered} other {# critical items were left unanswered}}
alarms.missed: checklist was not filled, the window closed at {time}
alarms.hidden: {count, plural, one {# more alarm} other {# more alarms}}: narrow the filters to see the rest
alarms.capped: The read limit was reached: there may be more alarms — narrow the filters
alarms.unknownTimezone: {count, plural, one {# pizzeria is not being watched} other {# pizzerias are not being watched}}: the database does not recognise their time zone — fix it in the catalog

list.title: Feed
list.limitReached: Showing the latest {count} submissions: narrow the period or the filters to see the rest

outcome.unanswered: {count, plural, one {# item unanswered} other {# items unanswered}}
outcome.failed: {count, plural, one {# item not done} other {# items not done}}
outcome.criticalFailed: {count, plural, one {# critical failed} other {# critical failed}}

empty.neverText: As soon as someone scans a station QR code and fills the checklist, the record shows up here.
empty.periodTitle: Nothing was filled in the selected period
empty.periodText: There are submissions for these filters, just on other days: widen the period or clear the filters.
empty.noStationsText: First add a store and a station in the reference, then print the station QR code — that is what the employee scans to fill the checklist.

card.title: {checklist} · {store}
card.snapshotNotice: The items are shown exactly as the employee saw them — version v{number} of {date}. Later edits of the checklist do not affect this card.
card.snapshotNoticeNoDate: The items are shown exactly as the employee saw them. Later edits of the checklist do not affect this card.
card.notFoundText: The link points to a submission that does not exist: the address may have a typo.
card.skippedByMode: {count, plural, one {# item was not asked in this mode} other {# items were not asked in this mode}}

library.title: Block library
library.notice: A block is created once and inserted into any number of checklists. Editing a block reaches every draft it sits in; already published checklist versions never change.
library.empty: The library has no blocks yet
library.emptyHint: Create a block once — then insert it into any number of checklists and edit it in one place.
library.noItems: The block has no items yet
library.usagesEmpty: The block is not inserted into any checklist.
library.impactDrafts: The edit reaches {drafts, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}}.
library.impactPublished: In {published, plural, one {# checklist} other {# checklists}} the block is part of a published version — those stay as they are until the next publish.
library.impactNoPublished: No published version contains this block.
